# OTT Advertising—Everything You Need to Know About Over the Top

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66fc0a29b3f1cec955eafcb6/673f8474acb80bfaf8869c5b_what-is-ott-advertising.png)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66fc0a29b3f1cec955eafcb6/6717c65418410859026b899c_avatar.png)

By 

Madhive Marketing

Published 

August 13, 2024

Table of contents

It wasn't long ago that linear TV was the only option for video entertainment. Netflix was one of the first to the streaming content scene, but options have since exploded.

Now, linear TV, streaming channels like Tubi and FuboTV, Youtube, TikTok, and many others are all competing for viewers’ time and attention.

As well as brands’ advertising dollars.

So whether you’re buying or selling ads in this environment, you should have a thorough understanding of OTT advertising.

You’re in the right place.

Let’s take a little tour through OTT ad basics and how to get started with over the top.

*   What is OTT advertising?
*   Primary types of OTT advertising
*   5 benefits of advertising on OTT
*   How does OTT advertising work?
*   How to buy OTT ads
*   How much do OTT ads cost?
*   2 successful OTT advertising campaigns
*   5 best practices for streaming video advertising
*   X of our favorite OTT commercials
*   How to prevent fraud in OTT

## What is OTT advertising?

**Over-the-top (OTT) advertising** refers to ads that are delivered via a streaming service during a viewer’s movie, TV show, or other video content.

These ads may play on an actual TV set (CTV advertising), but OTT advertising also includes video ads streamed on other connected devices — like phones, tablets, computers, gaming systems, etc.

### What’s so important about OTT ads?

OTT is becoming an increasingly important segment of the [$167.4B local advertising market](https://madhive.com/resources/article/OTT-statistics).

![image showing $167.4B in 2022 local advertising spend](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66fc0a29b3f1cec955eafcb6/671d5e500c0487cc1fc14416_image_2.png)

Even as local TV and cable spending is on the decline, OTT’s share of local advertising spend is on the rise. After growing by 57% to reach $2B in 2022, OTT spend is expected to reach $3.5B by 2026 — and it currently holds the title of fastest-growing local media segment.

![graph showing local media platform growth from 2021 to 2022](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66fc0a29b3f1cec955eafcb6/671d5e501d2c2b429085ff21_local_media_platform_growth_1.png)

One local TV group executive [BIA interviewed](https://madhive.com/resources/article/the-local-programmatic-market) sings the praises of OTT and programmatic trading to better serve his clients — and grow beyond his broadcast sales. His station aggressively markets audience extension through programmatic OTT. With this strategy, his station has grown its digital revenue to **25% of total revenue**, and this has been **growing up to 20% annually**.

‍

> “30% to 40% of TV ad campaigns’ impressions should come from over-the-top streaming in order to optimize results.”  
> ‍  
> Study Conducted by NBCU and iSpot

‍

**Get more OTT stats:** [OTT Statistics for Newbies—An Infographic to Get Your Grips](https://madhive.com/resources/article/OTT-statistics)

### OTT vs. CTV

OTT advertising and **connected TV (CTV)** advertising both deliver ads to viewers during video content, via the internet. The difference comes down to delivery.

**OTT** content can be delivered to any device, as long as it’s connected to the internet. [**CTV advertising**](https://madhive.com/resources/article/CTV-advertising) is a subset of OTT advertising and includes advertising played on an actual television set (either directly on a smart TV or via a streaming device like a Roku player or Firestick).

![chart showing difference between CTV and OTT vendors](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/66fc0a29b3f1cec955eafcb6/671d5e508e2701e7f9ffb21c_OTT_advertising_1.png)

So, if you’re watching the latest season of Succession on your iPhone, the commercials are considered OTT advertising. But if you’re streaming that same episode via your smart television, the commercials could also be called CTV advertising.

On most streaming services, [CTV represents over 80% of all viewing](https://www.conviva.com/state-of-streaming/). The remainder happens on other devices connected to the internet (laptops, smartphones and tablets) and falls into the broader OTT category.

### OTT vs. VOD

Ready for a few more digital media advertising acronyms? Next up is VOD — video on demand — and all its variations.

What’s the difference between OTT and VOD? At its simplest, **OTT is a subset of VOD**.

**OTT** refers to the delivery of video content over the internet, bypassing traditional television providers. **VOD** refers to any service that allows users to select and watch video content at their convenience — including cable TV or satellite providers, as well as TV streaming services like Netflix, Hulu, and Amazon Prime Video.

There are also several distribution models within the video-on-demand category.

| **VOD Distribution Models** |     |
| --- | --- |
| **VOD Model** | **What It Is** |
| Subscription Video on Demand (SVOD) | A recurring fee model for access to a library subscription content (e.g. Netflix, Disney+) |
| Transactional Video on Demand (TVOD) | A pay-per-view video distribution model (e.g. iTunes, Amazon Prime Video) |
| Advertising-Based Video on Demand (AVOD) | Provides an ad-supported distribution model (e.g. Hulu with ads) |

‍

## How does OTT advertising work?

When you buy advertising on OTT, your ads are shown to viewers during the movies, TV shows, and other videos they stream on their various connected devices. The streaming video content in which OTT ads are shown is provided by networks and publishers like Hulu, Peacock, Tubi, Pluto TV and Paramount.

Both Netflix and Disney+ recently began offering ad-supported video content, too.

### **OTT Advertising in India**

The Over-The-Top (OTT) media landscape in India represents one of the most explosive digital entertainment transformations globally. Driven by pervasive high-speed broadband, affordable smart televisions, connected living rooms, and an insatiable appetite for multi-lingual premium entertainment, traditional linear television consumption is rapidly yielding ground to on-demand streaming.

Today, Indian audiences consume content across a diversified spectrum of ad-supported streaming networks, premium hybrid subscription services, live sports broadcasts, and regional language portals. For brands, this evolution marks a fundamental shift in media planning. Modern advertisers are moving away from untargeted, static linear broadcast buys toward **programmatic Connected TV (CTV) advertising, non-skippable mid-roll storytelling, dynamic ad insertion, and deterministic cross-device retargeting**.

Choosing a top-rated OTT ad company in India ensures brands do not merely purchase ad inventory; they orchestrate data-driven, cinematic campaigns that command attention on the largest screen in the modern Indian household.

This comprehensive guide breaks down the core architecture of OTT media services in India, the mechanics of premium video ad buying, and the criteria required to select a market-leading OTT agency partner.

## **1\. The Shifting Dynamics of OTT Media Consumption in India**

### **The Connected TV (CTV) Boom in Urban Living Rooms**

Smart TV adoption across Tier-1 and Tier-2 metros has transformed the living room screen into a digital-first environment. Unlike personal smartphone viewing, CTV viewing is inherently co-viewing: multiple family members and decision-makers gather around high-production-value series, international cinema, and marquee sporting tournaments.

### **Hybrid Monetisation (AVOD vs SVOD)**

While pure subscription video on demand (SVOD) holds prestige, advertising-based video on demand (AVOD) and tiered hybrid models dominate audience volume in India. Viewers willingly accept contextual, high-definition commercial breaks in exchange for high-calibre programming, providing brands with captive, unskippable attention windows.

### **Regional Language Explosion**

The modern streaming viewer in India is intensely regional. Content consumption in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Bengali, and Marathi matches or exceeds English content consumption across major genres. Top OTT marketing companies utilize vernacular voiceovers, tailored cultural narratives, and geo-targeted creative to capture regional affinity.

## **2\. Core Service Verticals of a Premier OTT Ad Company**

### **Programmatic OTT Media Buying & Inventory Access**

*   Securing premium ad placements across top streaming platforms, CTV applications, and regional OTT networks.
*   Accessing private marketplace (PMP) deals and programmatic guaranteed (PG) buys to ensure brand-safe, prime-time inventory during flagship tentpole shows.
*   Managing real-time bidding (RTB) algorithms to balance reach, frequency, and cost efficiency across fragmented streaming platforms.

### **Precision Audience Graphing & Household Targeting**

*   Deploying deterministic targeting based on device category, household broadband IP, geographic pin code affluence, and viewing habits.
*   Re-engaging high-intent users on smartphones and tablets after they view a full 30-second non-skippable CTV commercial on the living room screen.
*   Integrating first-party CRM data to suppress existing customers or deliver personalised upsell campaigns to VIP segments.

### **High-Impact Interactive Video Formats & Dynamic Creative**

*   Producing cinema-grade 15-second and 30-second video assets optimised for surround sound and 4K display panels.
*   Engineering interactive shoppable video overlays, on-screen scannable QR codes, and companion banner ads that bridge brand awareness with instant mobile action.
*   Deploying Dynamic Creative Optimisation (DCO) to automatically serve contextually relevant ad copy based on the viewer’s location, local weather, or real-time sports scores.

### **Cross-Platform Attribution & Verification**

*   Eliminating bot fraud, invalid traffic (IVT), and unrendered impressions through strict verification partnerships (IAS, DoubleVerify, MOAT).
*   Tracking Brand Lift Studies, measuring ad recall, message association, and purchase consideration lift.
*   Mapping digital conversion paths from initial OTT ad exposure to final website transaction or app installation.

## **3\. How to Evaluate and Select the Best OTT Ad Company in India**

When vetting potential agency partners, marketing leadership should evaluate four critical benchmarks:

1.  **Direct DSP and Inventory Relationships:** Does the agency possess direct integrations with leading demand-side platforms and top domestic streaming networks, or do they purchase media through third-party intermediaries that mark up costs?
2.  **Measurement and Attribution Rigour:** Can the agency connect living room CTV impressions to mobile web visits, store footfall, or online checkouts with verified cross-device graphing?
3.  **Creative Production Expertise:** Does the agency understand how to format video assets specifically for wide-aspect smart screens with
